description: All current book prices for a single player across events and markets (player props). Use a player id from list_players. Paginate with cursor. This endpoint has NO scope filter, so the rows can mix game props with season-long futures (award odds, full-season stat lines) — those carry marketScope=SEASON and eventStartTime = the season anchor date, not a kickoff. To split them, use get_odds with player_id plus scope=event or scope=season.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Max rows to return (page size). Default 50, server caps apply.

name: get_player_odds
